action.rationale: Fresh start (round 0) with dim=30 and a tight total budget of 100 on a deterministic, cheap objective. Spending ~12% (~12 evals) on probes will characterize modality/conditioning and seed the archive so we can pick between TuRBO/CMA-ES or a local method with evidence.

Probes on 30D suggest multiple basins (P2 fdc_spearman -0.2727, top10_spread_vs_uniform 1.051; P1 log10_range 0.7971), so we need a global method. With 88 evals left and incumbent 611.793, a short race between TuRBO and CMA-ES will select the stronger approach while preserving ≥64 evals for the winner.

TuRBO won the race decisively (611.247 vs 612.816) and is active with tr_length=0.8 and not exhausted, while we have 64 evals left. Probes indicate dispersed good regions in 30D (top10_spread_vs_uniform=1.051), favoring TuRBO over local methods. The stall_evals=16 reflects no post-race progress yet, so continuing TuRBO is the most data-supported next step.
